integrity: A complete proof and a standalone deterministic exact verification script are included. Finite exhaustive experiments corroborate but do not prove all-size statements. No external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform synchronous XOR on finite sunlet graphs only; generic earlier additive-automaton multiplicity theory may imply aspects of this specialization; prior 1986 full text inaccessible. Arithmetic orbit census and constructive affine parity pairing are the assessed result, not a claim to new reversible-CA technology.
title: Period-parity involution and exact cycle census for sunlet-graph XOR dynamics
